scope: Independent CPU setup point-encoding comparison; no production changes, full setup rerun or proof E2E

method.oracle: Every output affine coordinate compared with direct ICICLE scalar multiplication; shared random generator/scalars within each curve and run, including 0, 1 and -1
method.timing: Total includes table allocation/precomputation, scalar conversion, multiplication, affine output conversion and final output allocation; excludes oracle/equality and JSON logging
method.icicle: Public precompute_bases plus one-base-per-MSM batched msm; default runtime thread count; no outer Rayon around ICICLE calls
method.arkworks: Current large-input strategy: 16,384-point table sizing hint, 1,024-point Rayon chunks, batch normalization and direct final-array writes
method.order: Candidate order rotates between trials; separate processes run sequentially
method.settings: 15 tested factor/window combinations, not an exhaustive optimizer; best at 1,024 points retested at 16,384
method.stageCaveat: arkworks multiplyMs includes scalar conversion, batch normalization and output writes; ICICLE affineMs is separate. Compare totalMs across implementations.
method.smallCheck: 17-point run is a single correctness screening trial, not a repeated performance conclusion; production retains direct ICICLE arithmetic below 16,384 points.

conclusion: Retain current arkworks large-input CPU path; tested ICICLE precomputation configurations remain slower. No inference about CUDA or other CPUs.
